snippet.title: Octopath Traveler 0 - Story Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/JP0082-PPSA28492_00-OCTOPATH000PS5JP

The OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 demo is available now! Start from Zero and play through the first 3 hours of the game. 
 
Embark on an adventure of your own creation. 
 
OCTOPATH TRAVELER 0 is out on PS5 and PS4 December 4 2025. Pre-order available now!
